rca of the issue: RCA: FastAPI code has explicit CORS+preflight logic for explicit origins with credentials, but live public endpoint still responds with wildcard origin on OPTIONS, indicating edge/proxy override outside application logic. Mitigation: adjust ingress/edge CORS policy precedence.
